preview.modelExplainer: The model heavily weights SG OTT at 1% and SG Total at 3%, making driving distance and overall scoring the dominant factors. Driving Accuracy at 0% is the least influential metric this week.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournamentRank and powerRank, prioritizing those who excel in the heavily weighted SG OTT and SG Total categories. Top-tier selections focus on players with strong SG OTT and SG Total marks, while mid-tier picks balance approach play and putting.

article.title: Baycurrent Classic Model Targets: Lee, Bridgeman, Morikawa Lead Yokohama Projections
article.dek: Tournament model ranks Min Woo Lee first, Jacob Bridgeman second, and Collin Morikawa third at Yokohama Country Club.
article.introduction: The Baycurrent Classic model places Min Woo Lee at tournament rank 1 with 693 SG Total, Jacob Bridgeman at rank 2 with 933 SG Total, and Collin Morikawa at rank 3 with 53 SG Total. All three players carry top-10 model ranks and skipped the Scottish Open with zero tracked rounds in the major swing workload window. Course weights emphasize SG OTT at 1 percent, aligning with the top three players' combined OTT strength.
